title: JuJu's Juneteenth Juke
headline: “A SINNERS THEMED JUKE JOINT PARTY? YES PLEASE!” - Revolt
intro: STRAW HAT GOOFY HOSTED THE SOULFUL PARTY OF THE SUMMER WITH JUJU’S JUNETEENTH JUKE

introPieces.html:
Famed TikToker and film commentator Straw Hat Goofy tapped IHC to bring to life Juju’s Juneteenth Juke, an intimate gathering full of soul, flavor and late-night rhythm. Built around the energy and community seen in Ryan Coogler’s acclaimed blockbuster Sinners, this Juneteenth celebration invited guests to move, connect and reflect through music, dance and shared joy.

Located at Sassafras Saloon, the party was full of life, with live music and smooth cocktails setting the tone. Guests were encouraged to come dressed in their vintage finest, ready to sip, sway, and celebrate the history and stories that brought us all together. An evening highlight included an intimate video address from Coolger himself!

pieces.html: Sassafras Saloon set the scene with vintage Southern charm, channeling the spirit of a Savannah townhouse. Antique details, rich textures, and warm lighting created a transportive, intimate atmosphere that perfectly echoed the soul of Sinners.

A Southern-styled photo moment, complete with immersive props, brought the world of Sinners to life, inviting guests to pose, share, and stake a few vampires along the way. As the evening unfolded, host Juju Green set the tone with a warm welcome, followed by a heartfelt pre-recorded message from Sinners director Ryan Coogler. 

DJ Dimi and Suga Shay kept the energy high with a seamless mix of soulful tracks that had the dance floor buzzing all night. From vintage fits to spontaneous laughter, the vibe was warm, vibrant, deeply communal, and fueled by great music, flowing cocktails, and a shared sense of joy that brought everyone together in celebration.

Sponsors Whistle Pig Whiskey, Gold Bar Whiskey, and Lipton Hard Iced Tea were seamlessly woven into the experience through crafted cocktails and branded touchpoints. Signature drinks like the slow-burning Barn Burn and the bright, deceptively smooth Sunset Sin reflected the soulful spirit of the night, while a refreshing, zero-proof option ensured there was something for everyone.

A classic Southern-inspired menu grounded the evening in comfort and flavor. Guests enjoyed bites like catfish sliders, vegan-friendly mac and cheese, and warm cornbread, all designed to complement the rhythm and richness of the celebration. As the night wore on, warm beignets were passed to guests, offering a sweet finish to an already flavorful experience.

Out on the patio, an intimate Gold Bar Whiskey tasting station offered a deeper dive into Southern flavor, adding another thoughtful layer to an already rich and soulful experience.

work.summary: Inspired by Ryan Coogler’s Sinners, we partnered with Juju Green to host a soulful Juneteenth celebration.
